label: sparse, diffuse e/u/d/z-context feature (no clean predicate)
explanation: Very sparse (0.03% of steps). Never fires at t=0-1, concentrated at t=3-5 and the matching copy-phase steps, enriched when there are no digits. Enriched contexts: inputs right after an e..u..d prefix (prev2=u, prev=d, 13x lift; top examples start with e u d), and copy-phase input z while outputting e (in_tok z 12x, out_tok e 16x lift). No single predicate tested gets above F1 0.15 on dev. The recorded disjunction (u-d bigram OR copy z->e) covers about 37% of mass at 9% precision. Count-of-recent-e/u/d predicates did worse. Magnitude modulators were not established.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=z (+7.20), prev_tok=d (+5.36), phase=2 & in_tok=e (+4.82), prev2_tok=u (+4.28), orig0=e (+3.80), prev_tok=u (+3.75). Lower it: correct=1 (-5.02), phase=2 (-3.87), orig1=s (-2.34), t=8 (-1.92).
